data.location: 483 Storrs Road, Mansfield, Connecticut
data.status: final day of business on Sunday, June 21st
data.short_description: Dad's Doughs is a mini-doughnut shop selling fresh-made mini doughnuts, drip coffee, and other beverages located in the former Town Garange building. The shop announced its final day of business will be Sunday, June 21st, with daily hours starting at 7am until sold out through closing day. The shop opened in November 2024 and cited insufficient foot traffic as the reason for closing.

data.location: 1445 New Britain Avenue, West Hartford, Connecticut
data.status: plans to open in the second half of 2026
data.short_description: Level99 is a first-of-its-kind experiential entertainment complex featuring over 50 real-world physical and mental challenges, games, and a restaurant. Exterior work is now underway at 1445 New Britain Avenue in West Hartford, with the previously yellow exterior repainted dark blue and new brick siding installed. Originally scheduled to open in late 2025, construction delays pushed the opening to the second half of 2026; the complex will accommodate 600 players and over 200 restaurant patrons at a time.

data.location: 28 Church Street, Naugatuck, Connecticut
data.short_description: Dumpling Eatery is a new take-out only restaurant serving a wide variety of dumplings, bubble tea/boba, and appetizers. It is coming soon to 28 Church Street in Naugatuck, the former home of Mike's Pizza Palace, which closed in November after 50 years in business. The restaurant will be owned by Jin Bing Lin, who also owns numerous other Asian-food concepts throughout Connecticut including Ramen & Bao and Tomo 68.

data.location: 360 Middle Turnpike West, Manchester, Connecticut
data.short_description: The Broken Yolk is a new family-friendly breakfast and lunch restaurant focused on fresh, high-quality breakfast classics, sandwiches, burgers, wraps, and daily specials. It is coming soon to 360 Middle Turnpike West in Manchester, the former home of Shady Glen & Ganymead at the Manchester Parkade Shopping Center. The restaurant will be owned by Andi & Heather Dhimitri, who previously owned and operated Andi's Pizzeria on Broad Street.

data.location: 122 Prospect Hill Road, East Windsor, Connecticut
data.status: opening date announcement coming very soon
data.short_description: Molly's Sweet Spot is a new bakery offering cakes, cupcakes, gourmet cookies, cakesicles, brownies, tiramisu, mousse cups, cinnamon rolls, donuts, muffins, scones, dirty sodas, and more. Located at 122 Prospect Hill Road in East Windsor within Sofia's Plaza, the bakery's interior is nearly complete with final decor and equipment touches being added. The bakery will be owned by local resident Molly Francia, with planned hours Wednesday through Sunday.

data.location: 51 Whitfield Street, Guilford, Connecticut
data.short_description: Ciao! Angie is a new Italian cafe offering breakfast and lunch including espresso-based drinks, paninis, salads, soups, and pastries, open daily from 8am to 5pm. The cafe is now open at 51 Whitfield Street in Guilford. The concept honors Angeline "Angie" Balzano, described as a fiercely Italian matriarch, and is rooted in the tradition of gathering around a table.

data.location: Address not specified
data.short_description: The SoNo Collection is a mall in Norwalk, Connecticut that has received a court-appointed receiver. Trigild IVL was named court-appointed receiver with sister company Centennial Real Estate Management taking over day-to-day management and leasing from GGP (formerly Brookfield Retail Properties). The article covers a management/ownership change and foreclosure proceedings — no qualifying opening, closing, or remodel event.

data.location: Holyoke Mall at Ingleside, second floor, Holyoke, Massachusetts
data.short_description: Exotic Snack Guys is a retail store selling snacks from 40 different countries, offering a cultural snack experience. The store is now open on the second floor of Holyoke Mall at Ingleside, across from Victoria's Secret. No further address details were provided in the article.

data.location: Holyoke Mall at Ingleside, second level, former Francesca's space next to Starbucks, Holyoke, Massachusetts
data.short_description: Otaku House is a retail store specializing in Japanese action figures, statues, accessories, and anime/Kawaii/Harajuku culture. The store has opened in the former Francesca's space next to Starbucks on the second level of Holyoke Mall at Ingleside. The store's goal is to introduce the Japanese counter-culture genre of anime and Kawaii to shoppers.

data.location: Holyoke Mall at Ingleside, former Things Remembered space, Holyoke, Massachusetts
data.status: will be moving to a larger location within Holyoke Mall
data.short_description: Pandora is a Danish jewelry retailer known for customizable charm bracelets, rings, earrings, and necklaces. The retailer will move to the former Things Remembered space in Holyoke Mall in late 2026, with construction anticipated to begin soon. The new space will be a larger location within the same mall.

data.location: Holyoke Mall at Ingleside, Holyoke, Massachusetts
data.status: temporarily closed while its store receives an extensive renovation
data.short_description: American Eagle is a clothing retailer currently undergoing an extensive renovation at its Holyoke Mall location. The new prototype store will feature a dark blue color scheme and wood grain finishes as part of the brand's fleet-wide refresh. The mall's Aerie location is also expected to receive an extensive remodel in the coming months.

data.location: Holyoke Mall at Ingleside, upper level, center court near the glass elevator, Holyoke, Massachusetts
data.short_description: Chick-Fil-A has opened a temporary pop-up stand inside Holyoke Mall on the upper level in center court near the glass elevator. The pop-up will remain open through August 31st, offering a smaller menu including Original Chicken Sandwiches, Spicy Chicken Sandwiches, Mac & Cheese, and Sweet Tea. No permanent opening or closing event is indicated beyond the pop-up duration.

data.location: Holyoke Mall at Ingleside, former Sears store, Holyoke, Massachusetts
data.short_description: Dick's House of Sport is a large-format sporting goods retailer featuring interactive spaces including rock climbing walls, batting cages, putting greens, a turf field, and more. The store is officially under construction in the former Sears location at Holyoke Mall and will now open in Summer 2028 after extensive renovations. The article notes the opening was pushed back due to the scope of renovations required.

data.location: Holyoke Mall at Ingleside food court, Holyoke, Massachusetts
data.short_description: Smoothie Island is a food court tenant at Holyoke Mall that successfully reopened following a fire that damaged the food court in February. The article notes the food court is still working to fully reopen, with most other tenants still closed. No specific reopening date is provided.

data.location: Holyoke Mall at Ingleside food court, Holyoke, Massachusetts
data.short_description: Onezo is a food court tenant at Holyoke Mall that successfully reopened following a fire that damaged the food court in February. The article notes the food court is still working to fully reopen, with most other tenants still closed. No specific reopening date is provided.

data.location: 54 Hazard Avenue, Enfield, Connecticut
data.status: new [building] will be constructed on the site
data.short_description: Speeders Car Wash is an incoming car wash chain, the new name/brand for Russell Speeders Car Washes, which plans to eventually rebrand all locations. A new 3,818 square foot building with a single tunnel bay and high-powered vacuums will be constructed at 54 Hazard Avenue in Enfield, the former site of the 99 Restaurant & Bar. Demolition of the former restaurant building is currently underway.

data.location: 54 Hazard Avenue, Enfield, Connecticut
data.short_description: Ninety Nine Restaurant & Bar (also referred to as 99 Restaurant & Bar) is a casual dining chain whose Enfield location at 54 Hazard Avenue is being demolished to make way for a new Speeders Car Wash. Demolition work is currently underway at the site. No closing date for the restaurant is stated in the article.

data.location: 50 Spring Street, Southington, Connecticut
data.status: will officially open its doors on Saturday, June 20th
data.short_description: Bloom Mama & Me PlayCafé is a new play cafe combining a relaxing café atmosphere with Montessori-style imaginative play areas for children ages 0–7, along with wellness-focused offerings for modern motherhood. The cafe will officially open its doors on Saturday, June 20th at 9am, with a ribbon cutting ceremony at 8:45am, at 50 Spring Street in Southington. Open play hours will be offered with one-time visit passes and monthly memberships available.

data.location: 1642 Boston Post Road, Milford, Connecticut
data.short_description: Crumbl Cookies is a cookie chain that has permanently closed its Milford location at 1642 Boston Post Road inside the Milford Marketplace shopping center after 3½ years of business. The business' last day appears to have been June 13th. Crumbl Cookies still has Connecticut locations in Stamford, Fairfield, Manchester, West Hartford, Avon, Shelton, Danbury, North Haven, and Waterbury, though a planned Meriden location has been cancelled.

data.location: Milford Marketplace, Milford, Connecticut
data.status: permanently closed its location in the plaza effective at the end of business on June 14th
data.short_description: Plan B Burger Bar is a restaurant that permanently closed its location in the Milford Marketplace shopping center. The closure took effect at the end of business on June 14th, making it the second loss for the shopping center that week alongside Crumbl Cookies. No street address is provided for this business in the article.
